assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Original editorial food photograph for a thoughtful home cooking app, not a UI mockup. Warm directional afternoon window light, subtle analog grain, natural imperfect handmade off-white stoneware, muted warm cream and olive palette, slightly rustic but carefully styled, magazine-quality food detail. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no people or hands. Believable delicious food, no surreal objects. Wide landscape 3:2 overhead photograph of a casual Mediterranean vegetarian dinner for four. On a pale warm limestone and oatmeal linen table: one large dark rust terracotta bowl of smoky tomato lentils with visible green-brown lentils and tomato, a separate cream platter of golden charred sliced zucchini with lemon, a smaller bowl of finely grained fluffy couscous with chopped herbs, and soft golden grilled flatbreads with brown blister marks. A cut lemon and a few sprigs of flat leaf parsley. Intimate generous spread with cropped edges, bowls clustered on right and lower portions, small calm linen area at upper left. Rich natural food colors, not overly saturated. Shoot directly overhead, every dish clearly distinct.
